title: Is Your Body Running Loud?
caption: Treat today like a body-check day. Take short walks or gentle stretches when you feel jumpy, and use slow breaths between tasks to keep your day paced.
snapshot: Recent flare activity and a reported CME have raised short-term variability. The background field is more active and feels unsettled. Expect more up-and-down sensations than usual.
affects: You might feel alert in bursts and drained soon after. Movement may help shift the jitter into something smoother, while sitting for long can amplify fatigue. Head pressure or mild anxiety may show up for some.
playbook:
- Do a brief walk or gentle stretch when you feel jumpy
- Add a calming slow-breathing break between tasks
- Stay hydrated and choose light, even meals
- Favor short rests over one long crash nap

fb.caption: Can't sleep and keep replaying the day in your head? Nights like this can feel extra noisy. There’s a bit more space activity recently, with a couple of solar flares and a recent CME recorded, and the planet’s background hum is a touch livelier than usual. For some people that shows up as an extra-chatty mind, shorter stretches of deep rest, or a wired feeling when you want to drop into sleep. Try making your evening simpler: dim lights earlier, set screens to softer tones, and give yourself a calm five-minute body scan before bed. If you wake, keep lights low and do slow breathing until your body settles. Gaia Eyes note: some days the Earth’s natural electromagnetic hum rises a bit — for some people that can make nights feel busier than normal.
